references.text: The same command to impress God's words on children and speak of them at home and away, when lying down and when rising up - this is the parallel text in the Shema passage
Moses exhorts the people to teach their children and grandchildren about what they have seen and experienced with God
The command to tell children about God's deeds and commands when they ask
The people are to gather to hear and learn the Lord's law, including children who do not know it
God gave testimony and law in Israel so that fathers would declare them to their children, so that the coming generation might know them
Train up a child in the way he should go - the principle of raising children in God's ways
Paul exhorts fathers to bring up their children in the discipline and instruction of the Lord - New Testament application of the principle
Timothy knew the holy Scriptures from childhood - an example of the fruit of faithful teaching of children
